title: California investigates Nvidia over whether chip exports ended up in China
summary_full: State attorney says scandal ‘raises bright red flags’ and aims to find out if company misled investorsCalifornia has served an investigative subpoena on Nvidia after a scandal that prompted the departure of co-founder and longtime chief executive Jensen Huang.Rob Bonta, the US state’s attorney general, issued the subpoena as part of an investigation into whether exports of the California-based company’s advanced semiconductor chips ended up in China, contravening US restrictions.
